FEATURES
 - Pregnancy tracking: Glow Nurture tracks your pregnancy from week to week, so you can see how your baby is growing and developing. You can also track your symptoms, moods, and weight gain.
 - Baby development: Glow Nurture provides you with detailed information about baby development, from conception to birth. You can learn about baby's physical and emotional development, as well as milestones to expect.
 - Community: Glow Nurture has a large and supportive community of moms. You can connect with other moms who are pregnant or who have recently given birth. You can also share your experiences, ask questions, and get advice.
 - Expert advice: Glow Nurture is backed by a team of experts in pregnancy and parenting. You can access articles, videos, and podcasts on a variety of topics, including nutrition, labor and delivery, and breastfeeding.
 - Contraction timer: Glow Nurture's contraction timer can help you track the frequency and intensity of your contractions, so you can know when it's time to head to the hospital.
 - Baby registry: Glow Nurture's baby registry makes it easy to create a list of the things you need for your baby. You can share your registry with friends and family, so they can easily purchase the items you need.
 - AI-powered insights: Glow Nurture uses AI to provide you with personalized insights and advice throughout your pregnancy. This information can help you understand your pregnancy, make informed decisions, and feel more confident as a mom.
 - Apple Health Integration: Sync data between Glow and Apple Health app.

BENEFITS
 - Peace of mind: Glow Nurture can help you feel more confident and prepared for your pregnancy. With Glow Nurture, you can track your pregnancy, learn about baby development, and connect with other moms.
 - Knowledge: Glow Nurture provides you with comprehensive information about pregnancy and parenting. You can learn about everything from conception to birth, and from nutrition to breastfeeding.
 - Support: Glow Nurture has a large and supportive community of moms. You can connect with other moms who are pregnant or who have recently given birth. You can also share your experiences, ask questions, and get advice.
